description: Shared cases for every reader of llm-kit graph catalogs, version 2 (version 1 plus a required `labels`). 'documents': each 'document' is a parsed catalog; 'expect' is 'valid' or 'invalid' (the schema refuses it). A valid case is also a page that llm_kit.graph.render.page.render_page draws; an invalid case is one it refuses. Reader rules the schema cannot state are in docs/reference/llm-kit-formats.md.
